cards.title: 题型

body.p: 对话题的材料是两人的日常交谈，每段后有 2 道题。录音只播放 1 遍。作答依据是听到的信息，不是对场景的常识判断。
按官方规格，这类录音通常有 35–100 词。本课练习分清对话中的目的、困难、方案和决定。

body.box:
Why does the customer need a different size?
What does Lee mean by “That settles it”?
What can be inferred about the assistant?
What will the customer probably do next?

cards.src: spec 第 12 页；lessonplan 第 3、7 页

steps.d: 开头通常说明要办的事。I need a costume for Saturday 是要租一套服装，Saturday 只是使用的时间。
转折词后面常是困难。听到提议，还要听对方是否接受。We could repair it 是方案，That would take too long 表示这个方案不用。
后续行动看最后接受的安排。Then I’ll collect it tomorrow 是决定，取件时间是 tomorrow，不是前面提过的 today。
why 问原因，mean 问一句话在语境中的意思，infer 问没有直说的信息，next 问下一步。Why does Lee mention tomorrow 问提到这个词的作用，答案不是日期本身。

cards.title: 对话结构
rows: 目的
说话人想办成的事
I need a costume for Saturday.
困难
妨碍办成这件事的情况
That size is already rented out.
方案
提出的替代办法，对方可能不接受
We could alter the larger one.
否定方案
说明某个办法行不通
The alteration would take too long.
决定
最后采用的办法和由谁去做
Then I’ll take the adjustable one.
补充条件
决定之后附加的要求
Bring it back before noon on Monday.
cards.note: 这几部分可以省略，也可以重复。We can alter it, but not before Monday 的后半句是对方案的限制。提出方案不等于已经决定。

cards.title: 问法与依据
rows: 细节或原因
录音中直接说出的事实或原因
Why does Lee reject the repair?
一句话的意思
结合前一句理解这句话
What does Lee mean by “That settles it”?
说话目的
这句话在对话中的作用
Why does Lee mention the opening time?
推断
把几条线索合起来，结论不超出录音
What can be inferred about Lee?
下一步
结尾的决定或表示接受的话
What will Lee probably do next?
cards.note: why 开头的题不都是原因题。Why does Lee need repairs 问事情的原因。Why does Lee say “It opens late” 问说这句话的目的。

body.box:
Customer: I need a frame for this drawing by tomorrow.
Assistant: A custom frame takes a week. There's a ready-made one, but it's slightly larger.
Customer: Would a border fill the space?
Assistant: Yes. I can cut one this afternoon.
Customer: Then I'll leave the drawing here and collect it tomorrow.

What will the customer probably do next?
1. Wait a week for a custom frame
2. Take the drawing away to measure it
3. Leave the drawing for fitting
4. Collect the finished frame this afternoon

body.p: probably do next 问下一步，依据在结尾。开头是装框的需求，中间的困难是定制要一周，加衬边是替代方案。
Then I’ll leave the drawing here 表示接受方案，第三项改写为 leave the drawing for fitting。this afternoon 是裁衬边的时间，不是取件时间。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 原先的目的
开头的期望不是结果，结果看结尾。
I hoped to collect it today. → It is ready today.
未采用的方案
方案后面有否定，就不是最后的办法。
A custom frame takes a week. → Wait a week.
责任人错误
核对由谁做：I can cut 是店员裁。
I can cut one. → The customer will cut it.
时间关系错误
分开加工的时间和取件的时间。
Cut it this afternoon; collect it tomorrow.
问法错误
原因题找原因，不找结尾的决定。
Why reject the repair? → Collect it tomorrow.

lines.text: I'd like to donate this coat.
The lining's torn. We can only accept clothes that are ready to wear.
I'll have it repaired first.

options: The request to donate a coat
The description of its damaged lining
The plan to repair the coat
The reference to wearable clothing as a goal
items.why: The lining’s torn 说明衣服不能马上接收，这是困难，即第二项。修补是之后的安排。

lines.text: I wanted a seat near the front.
Those seats are taken, but the back row has space.
The back is fine. I'll sit there.

items.stem: What kind of information does “What will the visitor do next?” ask for?
options: The reason front seats are occupied
The meaning of the word space
An action based on the final decision
A description of the original preference
items.why: do next 问的是行动。I’ll sit there 是结尾的决定，即第三项。

lines.text: Could I buy a small jar of this paint?
We only have large jars today.
That would be far more than I need.

items.stem: Which part explains why the available option is unsuitable?
options: The customer’s opening request
The clerk’s description of the stock
The clerk’s reference to today
The customer’s final response
items.why: far more than I need 说明大罐用不完，现有的选择不合适。这句是顾客最后的回答，即第四项。

lines.text: Pat, the ferry trip is canceled because of the fog.
Then let's visit the indoor market instead.

items.stem: What does “Why is the ferry trip canceled?” ask about?
options: The stated reason for a change
The meaning of the suggested destination
The likely result of visiting the market
The purpose of Pat’s reply
items.why: 题干问事情的原因，because of the fog 直接说出了原因，即第一项。

lines.text: I need a quiet spot for a phone interview.
The lounge is empty now, but a tour group arrives soon. Try the small office.
Isn't it being painted?
That finished yesterday. I'll unlock it.
Thanks. I'll wait here while you get the key.

items.stem: Which part rules out the lounge?
options: The request for a quiet place
The warning about an arriving group
The question about painting
The offer to unlock the office
items.why: a tour group arrives soon 说明休息室很快会变吵，即第二项。

items.stem: Which question explicitly asks for an inference?
options: Where will the interview take place?
When did the painting finish?
What does the helper’s offer suggest about access to the office?
Why is the lounge unsuitable?
items.why: 第三项用 suggest 问没有直说的信息：从 I’ll unlock it 可推断办公室要有人开锁。其余三问的答案都在录音中直接说出。

lines.text: I'm arranging a cake delivery for our team lunch.
We can deliver in the morning, but someone must sign for it.
Our office won't open until noon. Could it go to the reception desk next door?
Yes, if their staff agree to accept it.
I'll ask them now, then confirm the address with you.

items.stem: Which part introduces the difficulty with morning delivery?
options: The statement that the office opens at noon
The request for a cake for lunch
The suggestion of the neighboring reception desk
The plan to confirm the delivery address
items.why: 早晨送达要有人签收。Our office won’t open until noon 说明早上没人签收，这是困难，即第一项。

items.stem: What kind of information does “What will the organizer probably do next?” require?
options: The reason a cake was ordered
The meaning of the delivery address
The opening time of the office
The action indicated by the final plan
items.why: probably do next 问下一步，依据在结尾。I’ll ask them now 是先去问隔壁前台，即第四项。

lines.text: I'd like to try the pottery wheel during the open studio.
The wheels are reserved for members. Visitors can make a bowl by hand.
I was hoping to use a wheel. Can I become a member today?
Yes, but the safety introduction is tomorrow, and members must attend it first.
All right. I'll make a bowl by hand today and attend tomorrow's introduction.

items.stem: Which information limits the membership option for today?
options: Visitors may make a bowl by hand.
Members must first attend tomorrow’s introduction.
The visitor hoped to use a wheel.
The visitor plans to join the introduction.
items.why: the safety introduction is tomorrow 和 members must attend it first 合起来说明今天不能用陶轮，即第二项。

items.stem: Which question asks about an explicitly stated reason?
options: What does the visitor’s final reply imply?
What will the visitor probably do tomorrow?
Why can’t a new member use a wheel today?
What does the visitor mean by “All right”?
items.why: 第三项问今天不能用陶轮的原因，录音中直接说了。其余三问分别问推断、下一步和一句话的意思。

lines.text: I want to record bird calls on the trail this evening.
The recorder's available, but its battery won't last until dark.
Could I carry a spare?
We don't have one. The observation hut has power, though.
Then I'll record from the hut. I'll collect the recorder before I leave.

items.stem: Which part provides an alternative after the spare-battery idea fails?
options: The statement about power in the hut
The request to record bird calls
The statement that a recorder is available
The promise to collect the recorder
items.why: 没有备用电池之后，The observation hut has power, though 提出了替代办法，即第一项。

items.stem: What does “What does the visitor mean by ‘Then I’ll record from the hut’?” ask for?
options: The remaining length of the recording session
The reason the spare battery is unavailable
The location where the recorder will be collected
The meaning of the reply in the discussion
items.why: mean by 问一句话在对话中的意思，即第四项。Then I’ll record from the hut 表示接受去有电源的小屋录音。
